topic: Buying Signal Detection - Budget Allocation Confirmed

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Rachel, we've allocated $180K in this year's budget for network infrastructure upgrade. Need to move quickly to spend it before year-end.
transcript.buying_markers: Budget confirmed, urgency established, spending deadline

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent! That budget aligns well with our Enterprise solution. To ensure we meet your year-end deadline, I'll expedite the proposal and implementation timeline.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Perfect. I've already cleared this with our board. What do you need from me to fast-track the contract?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll send the contract today with expedited terms. We can have installation completed within three weeks to meet your budget deadline.
